title: aa0de0cc-26d4-b971-f846-cdefeb7de509
texts: NetSuite stays your ERP. Kitchens speak their orders and check each line, with no extra module.

title: 30eca3b1-355f-d5c6-f4fb-ee5bcf22094e
texts: Aptean keeps lots, catch weights and recalls. Kitchens that call speak their orders instead.

title: bc602e94-1436-b4e3-8a21-d8367cea1106
texts: Acumatica keeps its portal and the books. Kitchens that never log in speak the order instead.

title: 249b883a-3c07-610f-3492-75e97a12b2a3
texts: Business Central stays your ERP. Kitchens check every line before the order is sent.

title: ef755320-d69d-3f0f-cac9-ca48fe87edb2
texts: Odoo keeps every app it runs. Chefs say what ran short today and check each line.

title: 305d379e-3991-06ed-aef0-91c1f0f7bb17
texts: Sage X3 keeps the setup your partner built. Add the kitchen side: orders spoken and checked.

title: 92ab0ed1-f6df-6ff4-8e9b-37680d76a9b7
texts: Syspro keeps the plant, stock and books. A kitchen's call becomes a written order it checks.

title: 3630395b-e1e8-feca-1d9e-9305ebca80d8
texts: Prophet 21 keeps order entry and the books. Kitchens speak their own orders, so fewer calls reach inside sales.

title: 9305cf49-01d5-0b00-026f-9361a00f62de
texts: Cin7 keeps your stock and channels. Add one for kitchens that phone: a spoken, checked order.

title: e3d9473d-31d0-ea5f-7cf5-c5bb74a7ff81
texts: Zoho Inventory keeps stock and price lists. Restaurants speak orders into an app and check each item.

title: fbe128e4-3bbb-9837-08bf-a54c505727e3
texts: inFlow keeps stock and the Showroom. Kitchens that would rather say an order than shop for it can.

title: 60c56cb6-b82b-e9c0-b5a2-5531193ceae6
texts: Fishbowl keeps stock, picking and the QuickBooks sync. Less gets typed from a phone call.

title: 654bc591-bed7-4890-338c-99418b333d0d
texts: Unleashed keeps stock and the B2B Store. Chefs speak and check their own orders, so fewer pass through a rep.

title: 99127c0c-4ac0-f614-422f-887e2b8dcd0f
texts: Brightpearl's rules act on each order. Chefs fix any item first, so the rules act on what they meant.

title: 593d29f3-3634-9bd0-85e9-7e0808746613
texts: OroCommerce keeps corporate buying. Chefs with a short reorder say it into an app and check it.

title: 73163c48-c9e0-947e-b0da-ced4acb6bdc9
texts: Keep the Shopify B2B store. Chefs who would rather call say the order in an app instead.

title: fc08a83d-d657-d572-f26d-ad0a133f4c1f
texts: Sana Commerce serves buyers who log in. Chefs who still call say what they need and check it.

title: 9b4afb2d-41e8-35d4-bf51-6cced8adc215
texts: B2B Wave keeps the portal and standing orders. A chef who calls approves each item while ordering.

title: faa56e25-42b6-bd43-6069-230d83dfe1f4
texts: RepZio helps your reps sell. Restaurants reorder what the rep sold by voice, from your guide.

title: 5f7ea7a8-04ae-5279-8232-abe4c1a8358d
texts: SPS Commerce handles EDI accounts. Restaurants that phone or text say the order and check it.

title: 7bb51cea-ce2a-cfb8-9b2a-d31cfa1974a2
texts: TrueCommerce connects your EDI partners. Restaurants that still phone get an app to say each order.

title: 5fca9934-49f0-5c99-1cd8-4c71cddd5ab8
texts: Conexiom reads emailed purchase orders. Restaurants that phone speak orders from your guide.

title: a3291d2e-26e1-be39-3b72-ba86bedef6fd
texts: Esker processes what reaches your inbox. Add the orders that start outside it, spoken and checked.

title: 10c3696b-f7b7-a965-77be-a3e30ab190c4
texts: TradeGecko closed. Replace the ordering part only: restaurants say each order in an app.

title: e74b0d47-ac13-ae24-87e6-3abad8212116
texts: Toast takes your guests' orders. Speak your own order to a distributor that offers our app.

title: ecc12709-5730-765d-71f0-8dcad960f0b2
texts: Keep Lightspeed for guests and stock. Speak the supply order to a distributor on our app.

title: a4b8a604-b802-7740-9c66-eb76fc9d5b70
texts: TouchBistro keeps running service. Say the supply order to a distributor on our app.

title: 6620f619-9855-3e09-f32e-4530d7b5f266
texts: Lavu logs supply orders but sends nothing. With a distributor on our app, say it and send it.

title: 8e89452d-5aba-dd11-b679-4d4b39859b3d
texts: Altametrics keeps shifts, cash and reports. Say the supply order to a distributor on our app.

title: 92ff8af0-57af-1cd2-8925-c3503b9d4c49
texts: Crunchtime keeps counts and forecasts. Speak the order to a local distributor that offers our app.
